name: Sarkhan Vol
description: Sarkhan Vol is a dragon-worshipping planeswalker native to Tarkir, a former Mardu warrior and one-time servant of Nicol Bolas.

description_citations.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Sarkhan Vol is a dragon-worshipping planeswalker native to Tarkir, a former Mardu warrior and one-time servant of Nicol Bolas.

citations.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: A Mardu wing leader and feared battle mage, he became a planeswalker when a fire dragon burst from his body and burned his men and his enemies.

citations.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.
"Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: He travelled from plane to plane seeking a dragon to serve, declared fealty to Nicol Bolas on Jund, and was left disillusioned, falling into madness before a voice he believed was Ugin's led him back to Tarkir.

citations.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Aided by Narset at the cost of her life, he travelled back in time and saved Ugin from Bolas by wrapping him in a hedron cocoon.

citations.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.
"The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.
"Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Pulled back to an altered present, he found a Tarkir ruled by dragons where no one knew him, learned from Ugin that his home timeline never existed and that he was never born, and found this timeline's Narset alive.

citations.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.
"Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.
"Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

bio.text: Years later, stripped of his power and unable to take his draconic form, he lived in a hut in Mardu territory and attacked Elspeth, who defeated him.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

bio.text: With Taigam guiding him, he cut out a young dragon's heart and bit into it, regained a giant dragon form, and took command of the wild dragons.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

bio.text: He vowed to bathe the Multiverse in fire, and Ugin burned him with ghostfire so that he dived away through the storm.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.
"Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

status.text: As of the latest story, Sarkhan is alive and still commanding the dragons, having fled through the storm after Ugin burned him with ghostfire.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Rakka convinces Kresh and his clan to hunt a hellkite; on the way her stone elementals defeat attacking viashino, and they meet Sarkhan Vol.
timeline.quote: They also caught up with Sarkhan Vol , who offered his aid in confronting the dragon.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakka saves Sarkhan Vol and presents her master Nicol Bolas to him.
timeline.quote: Later, she saved Sarkhan Vol and presented to him her master, Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan's change to Tarkir's history means he is never born, a grandfather paradox; he survives as an orphan of time and is returned to the present.
timeline.quote: Dubbed since then an orphan of time, he was returned to the time stream's present moment.

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Mechanisms and paradoxes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol encases the defeated Ugin in a hedron cocoon.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon, putting him in a healing stasis.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The "Empty Quarter" (3000 AR to 3285 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol praises the dragon as a marriage of power and will.
timeline.quote: The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it.

citation.text: Crucible of Fire (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol calls the dragon hunger, heat and need without pretense.
timeline.quote: The dragon has no pretense of compassion, no false mask of civilization

citation.text: Hellkite Overlord (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol declares destruction a language everyone understands.
timeline.quote: Destruction is a language everyone understands.

citation.text: Violent Ultimatum (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Alara, Sarkhan swears allegiance to Bolas and exchanges blood with him.
timeline.quote: Upon that spot, Sarkhan swore his allegiance to Bolas and exchanged blood with the dragon

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Alara Unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan's mind unravels after he sees Bolas absorb the Maelstrom and be defeated by a duplicate avatar.
timeline.quote: Seeing his master defeated caused something within Sarkhan to snap, and his mind started to unravel.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Alara Unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani makes his first planeswalk, to the shard of Jund, and meets Sarkhan Vol, who teaches him red magic to express his rage.
timeline.quote: On Jund Ajani met the planeswalker Sarkhan Vol

citation.text: "Ajani: Faces of a Planeswalker". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives on Jund, where Sarkhan Vol advises him.
timeline.quote: Ajani found himself on Jund

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Alara unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crossing Bant, the knight recalls Sarkhan Vol and begins to have night-terrors of a dragon bursting from his body.
timeline.quote: They were night-terrors in which his body tore apart, revealing a fledgling dragon inside

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol acquires the power to summon Karrthus personally and they wreak havoc together.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol acquires the power to summon this tyrannical brute personally.

citation.text: "Jund's Trump Card". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol notes that many fools' chests burst trying to contain sangrite.
timeline.quote: Sangrite is the dragon's beating heart.

citation.text: Sangrite Backlash (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol says rage yearns to betray its rational prison.
timeline.quote: Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison.

citation.text: Act of Treason (Magic 2010, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana blows Kothophed apart and her tattoos begin to bleed.
timeline.quote: she blew him apart while his words echoed in her mind

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "The Veil's Curse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Chandra defeat Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: With it, the pair defeated Sarkhan, knocking the entire group unconscious.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anowon discovers Chandra has a physical map and tries to kill her; Sarkhan Vol knocks him out.
timeline.quote: He soon discovered that Nalaar actually possessed a physical map and so tried to kill her.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anowon betrays Chandra and tries to kill her in her sleep; Sarkhan knocks him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Luckily for Chandra, Sarkhan Vol ambushed Anowon, rendering him unconscious with a swift strike to the head.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The meeting of Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace in the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds and they rise to feed again.
timeline.quote: they rose to feed on the life of Zendikar again.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Sarkhan to guard the Eye; Chandra and Jace, guided by Anowon, confront him there, and Chandra's invisible flame spell loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
timeline.quote: thus unknowingly loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Second breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Sarkhan deal with the aftermath of releasing the Eye of Ugin seal.
timeline.quote: Enter the Eldrazi is a webcomic about Jace and Sarkhan as they deal with the aftermath of releasing the Eye of Ugin seal.

citation.text: "Rise of the Eldrazi", section "Webcomic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan wanders the Eye of Ugin on Bolas's orders and saves Chandra from Anowon.
timeline.quote: he became lucid in time to save Chandra Nalaar from an attack by the vampire ruin sage named Anowon

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan attacks Chandra as a dragon; Jace and Chandra defeat him with Ugin's invisible fire, unlocking the Eldrazi confinement.
timeline.quote: But this action unwittingly opened the last lock of the Eldrazi confinement spell.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan takes a hedron chunk to Bolas's Meditation Realm, where Bolas reveals he meant to free the Eldrazi all along.
timeline.quote: Bolas reveals he intended to free the Eldrazi all along

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, Chandra, Sarkhan and Nissa's actions free the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: freed the Eldrazi titans.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The meeting of Vol, Nalaar and Beleren at the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
timeline.quote: The meeting of Vol, Nalaar, and Beleren in the Eye of Ugin chamber loosened the bonds that kept the Eldrazi in torpor

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas was active on Zendikar through his instrument Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: he was active there through his instrument Sarkhan the Mad

citation.text: "What Is Flavor?". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol ultimately sides with Bolas, leaving Jund without a planeswalker hero.
timeline.quote: ultimately, Sarkhan sided with the mighty dragon.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan succumbs to Bolas's rule.
timeline.quote: the dragon-worshipper having succumbed to Bolas's rule.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas's long-term collecting of relationships is cited: Sarkhan Vol became Sarkhan the Mad and Tezzeret the Seeker became Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret the Seeker is now Tezzeret, Agent of Bolas

citation.text: "The Feedbackening 2011". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With Jace's help, Chandra casts a fire spell that cannot be seen and brings down the transformed Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: With his encouragement, she cast a fire spell that could not be seen

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Awakenings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Sarkhan sends Ugin into slumber in 3279 AR, Dromoka's brood commits systematic genocide against the Abzan.
timeline.quote: Dromoka and her brood thus laid a systematic genocide on the Abzan, to the point of utter desperation.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels back in time, saving Ugin and reviving dragons.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan traveled back in time, bringing dragons back to life as he saved Ugin's life

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the new timeline, efreets join the Atarka Clan after Sarkhan conquers Qadat.
timeline.quote: Efreets became part of the Atarka Clan after the dragonlord conquered Qadat.

citation.text: "Efreet", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dragons, which once inhabited Tarkir, were all killed long before Sarkhan's time.
timeline.quote: all of whom were killed long before Sarkhan's time

citation.text: "Khans of Tarkir", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol travels from the present to the past and rescues Ugin, changing the time stream, then returns to an alternate present.
timeline.quote: he changed the time stream by rescuing Ugin

citation.text: "Khans of Tarkir block", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol saves Ugin from death, diverging the current timeline from the original in 3279 AR.
timeline.quote: diverging from the original one in 3279 AR by Sarkhan Vol saving Ugin from death

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline, a Kirin guides Narset to the suffering Sarkhan Vol, whom she calms and agrees to bring to Ugin's Tomb.
timeline.quote: Narset was approached by a Kirin which guided her to the suffering Sarkhan Vol

citation.text: "Narset", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Ugin's Tomb, Zurgo attacks Sarkhan; Narset fights him but is distracted and killed while urging Sarkhan into the Nexus of Fate.
timeline.quote: she was distracted by Sarkhan which enabled Zurgo to land a killing blow

citation.text: "Narset", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is sent back in time from the valley, and Sorin's Restoration awakens Ugin, breaking the crucible.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol was sent back in time from this location

citation.text: "Qal Sisma", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan goes through the Nexus of Fate and saves Ugin by encasing him in hedrons; Sorin's Restoration later frees him in 4559.
timeline.quote: In 4559 Sorin's Restoration broke the crucible and restored Ugin to life.

citation.text: "Qal Sisma", section "Historical". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As a Mardu general, Sarkhan is touched by an ancient dragon spirit, sacrifices his men in a massive spell and ascends as a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Sacrificing his men, he unleashed a massive spell that wiped the battlefield clean as he ascended

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan returns to Tarkir; Narset calms his mind and he tells her about planeswalkers and Bolas.
timeline.quote: Narset's gentle nature helped Sarkhan to focus his mind temporarily.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Return to Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo kills Narset at Ugin's Tomb and Sarkhan enters the Nexus of Fate.
timeline.quote: which enabled Zurgo to land a killing blow

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Return to Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol's spark ignites and he leaves Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Planeswalker's spark ignites and he leaves Tarkir.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Khans of Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, Narset and Zurgo reach Ugin's Nexus and Sarkhan travels 1280 years back in time.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan enters the Nexus of Fate and travels 1280 years backward in time.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Khans of Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon, increasing the dragon tempests and creating the current timeline.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon. The dragon tempests increase.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Current Timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol uses Ugin's Nexus to travel 1,280 years back to the fight between Bolas and Ugin.
timeline.quote: he traveled 1,280 years back to the pivotal fight between Bolas and Ugin .

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Sarkhan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels back through the Nexus of Fate and uses a hedron shard to create the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, saving Ugin and changing Tarkir's timeline.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan created the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon to save Ugin and thereby alter the fate of the entire plane.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Ugin's Rescue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol, mind unraveling, returns to Tarkir in disgrace and begins to hear a voice.
timeline.quote: I return in disgrace because no other plane will have me.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls Bolas sending him to the Eye of Ugin to watch, and being left blinded and sleeping.
timeline.quote: Bolas sent me to the Eye. He told me to wait.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Bolas treated him as a mere pawn and dismissed him as a dragon's toy.
timeline.quote: I am dismissed, a dragon's toy, tossed aside and useless.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan grows up among the Mardu Horde as a feared battle mage and wing leader, scorching clans of the hinterlands.
timeline.quote: Talent with battle magic, and natural ferocity, made me feared among the Horde.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: sick of endless blood, Sarkhan leaves his clan for the Qal Sisma Mountains, where a figure takes his shape and he joins the whisperers' chant of dragons.
timeline.quote: They remembered the old ones.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan returns and the hordechief Zurgo demands his obedience, sending him against the Sultai.
timeline.quote: The Helmsmasher grudgingly sent me forth with a wing of riders to challenge the Sultai

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: in a stalemated battle Sarkhan kills the Sultai sorcerer, finds a quiet point, hears an ancient voice and a fire dragon bursts from his soul, burning everything.
timeline.quote: From my soul, a being of pure fire burst into the sky.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan is cast to an alien desert world and spends years watching and following dragons, seeking a king to honor.
timeline.quote: I spent the next years watching and following, learning all I could about the dragons.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on Jund Sarkhan finds the dragons magnificent but unworthy and fights alongside tribes hunting Malactoth.
timeline.quote: Old Malactoth— he had been a true challenge.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls the name Ugin as the dragon he should have heeded, and hears a voice telling him to find the doorway.
timeline.quote: The world remembers what its people have forgotten.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to seek the whisperers of the mountaintops again to find the door and make Tarkir strong again.
timeline.quote: I will make us strong again.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: A messenger reveals the Temur attacked because a man calling himself Sarkhan turned into a dragon in Temur forests and the Temur mistook him for the new Mardu khan.
timeline.quote: He…they say he turned into a dragon. And breathed fire on them, took off, and flew farther into Temur territory.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo declares Vol must die, and Varuk warns he is too dangerous, recalling Vol's desertion and dragonfire against the Mardu army.
timeline.quote: I was there when he turned into a great flying beast of flame and roasted your army with his breath.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Left alone, Zurgo resolves to kill Vol, refusing to wipe Batar's blood from his blade until it mixes with Vol's.
timeline.quote: He would not clean it until it had mixed with Vol's.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo kills a dying Temur woman after learning Vol went toward the Spirit Dragon's tomb, then rides there alone.
timeline.quote: He plunged his sword into the woman's throat and she stopped moving.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan wanders the barren dunes of Tarkir, shouting at the ghost in his mind before heading to a distant peak.
timeline.quote: "Stay out of my mind, ghost!" he cries.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets Narset below her mountain; she touches his forehead and senses another presence with him.
timeline.quote: "I see…another…with you. Around you. Like an echo of a shadow."

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recounts his travels since leaving Bolas's meditation realm and his flight back to Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Of the voice that constantly spoke to him, driving him ever onward until he fled back to Tarkir.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan's dragonfire reveals words on the fragment: look to the past and open the door to Ugin.
timeline.quote: 'Look to the past and open the door to Ugin.'

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset offers to take Sarkhan to the tomb of the Spirit Dragon.
timeline.quote: I can take you to the tomb of the Spirit Dragon.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset explains the Nexus as they climb the Qal Sisma range.
timeline.quote: There, reality is always shifting and twisting, as though seeking a final form but never finding it.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zurgo ambushes Sarkhan and Narset stops his blow and breaks his fist.
timeline.quote: "I have you, traitor!" roared Zurgo, as he chopped with his butcher's blade.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset urges Sarkhan to go on and holds Zurgo off.
timeline.quote: I will guard your passage.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan's dragonfire opens a gate and he charges through it, leaving Zurgo and Narset's body.
timeline.quote: With a bellow, equal parts rage and release, Sarkhan charged into the flaring arch.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges in darkness on a snowy Temur tundra after passing through the flaming gate, with the gate gone and Ugin's voice silent.
timeline.quote: But now he was standing still in the darkness in the middle of a vast, snowy Temur tundra.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan grieves that Narset died and cries out to Ugin, realizing the voice in his head is gone.
timeline.quote: The ceaseless whispering, the constant flow of Ugin's words in his head—the voice was gone!

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan falls to his knees, begging Ugin to speak, then laughs hysterically at the irony of wanting the whispers back.
timeline.quote: You can't be silent now!

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: A storm of luminous clouds breaks over the tundra and dragons emerge from the tempest, to Sarkhan's amazement.
timeline.quote: A dragon!

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees antlered dragons on Tarkir and realizes that the gate has taken him to Tarkir's past, as Narset's scrolls foretold.
timeline.quote: And it had led him to the past. It had led him here.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan follows the fledglings' flight across the tundra, believing this to be his path of healing for his plane.
timeline.quote: This was his path, the path that Ugin had set him on, the path of healing for his plane.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: A great dominant dragon arrives and leads the fledglings in formation to hunt.
timeline.quote: She had come to lead them. Now they would hunt.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: The dragons raid a human encampment in a basin while Sarkhan watches in awe.
timeline.quote: The brood descended like a barrage of flaming arrows.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: A fledgling's gaze welcomes Sarkhan to its brood and he begins to transform into a dragon.
timeline.quote: His transformation began without a conscious thought, without his permission

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: A human warrior woman with a glowing red claw and her sabertooth kill two fledglings, interrupting Sarkhan's transformation.
timeline.quote: As the fallen dragon turned on her, she cut through its face from eye to jaw.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, enraged, is about to attack the warrior but is stopped by a calm memory of how dragons brought balance, and his anger turns to awe at her.
timeline.quote: She was a survivor—no, a conqueror!—following a battle with dragons.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to make sure dragons are waiting for Narset when she lives again on Tarkir, believing the past is gone and this is a new Tarkir.
timeline.quote: when Narset lived again on Tarkir, there would be dragons waiting for her.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan embraces the new beginning, calling it his Tarkir.
timeline.quote: This was a new beginning, a new Tarkir—his Tarkir.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas and Ugin, long-time rivals, finally clash in the sky above Tarkir, and Sarkhan arrives to watch.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas and Ugin—two of the most powerful Planeswalkers the Multiverse has ever known—finally clashed in the sky above Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the whispers in his head were Ugin's plea leading him across time, and that his choice will reforge Tarkir's fate.
timeline.quote: they were a plea from Ugin that had led Sarkhan across time to this place and this moment.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, arrived in Tarkir's past, follows the woman with the dragon-claw staff up a mountain by her trail of marks.
timeline.quote: gouged two sweeping curves into it with the clawed staff she carried.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova's sabertooth tackles Sarkhan from behind and pins him in the snow.
timeline.quote: Something slammed into him from behind, huge and living and warm.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova questions Sarkhan, who says he follows the whispers of Ugin and thinks she may be his spirit guide.
timeline.quote: I seek the great dragon Ugin.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan gives his name; she greets him mockingly as 'khan of khans,' and he declines to claim dominion, bowing and flattering her as he once did Bolas.
timeline.quote: Yasova Dragonclaw of the Temur pays her respects to you, O khan of khans, and bids you welcome to her lands.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova threatens to kill Sarkhan unless he gives a reason to be spared; he kneels and offers to serve her.
timeline.quote: Give me a reason to spare you, Vol, or I'll kill you and be on my way.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan tells Yasova that in his homeland there are no dragons or dragon tempests, only bones, and that Ugin is long dead.
timeline.quote: Not in all of Tarkir," he said. "Only bones.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova confirms that she believes the dragons fall if Ugin dies, and Sarkhan realizes a storm guided him to her.
timeline.quote: If Ugin dies, the storms cease. The dragons fall.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova furiously rejects Sarkhan's claim that her people are better than the weak khans of his time, saying she has seen a paradise with no dragons.
timeline.quote: But I've seen the unwritten myself, seen a world with no dragons. And it was paradise.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the dragon in her vision was Bolas, already on Tarkir in the past.
timeline.quote: Bolas was already here!

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon, breathes fire to push Yasova aside rather than fight, and flies off to protect Ugin.
timeline.quote: With a kick from his powerful legs, Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, flying in dragon form toward the tempests, despairs that Bolas's influence has already reached this ancient time.
timeline.quote: the influence of Bolas had somehow made it here before him

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the circular chain: Bolas killed Ugin, ending the dragons, which led Sarkhan to revere dragons and bow to Bolas.
timeline.quote: Bolas had killed Ugin over some ancient feud.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to climb and reforge the chain, holding the hedron shard from Ugin's chamber.
timeline.quote: If he was still here, still alive, then there was a chance he could reforge the chain.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan breaks through the clouds and sees Ugin flying like a comet, and resolves to help him fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: The shimmering, ghostlike dragon Ugin flew across the atmosphere like a comet, dragging a tail made of storm.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees Yasova's claw-rune pathway tracking the tempests, meant as a guide for Bolas.
timeline.quote: This pattern was meant to be seen from the air—by Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ugin roars and calls Tarkir's dragons to his side; they stream out of the tempests.
timeline.quote: Dragons appeared in droves, flying out of the dragon tempests toward the fight.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Yasova's elemental spell strikes dozens of dragons, including Sarkhan, and turns them against Ugin.
timeline.quote: Yasova's power drowned out the force of Ugin's call, and the dragons converged on Ugin instead of Bolas.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan fights the spell, shouts no, and forces himself out of dragon form, then falls.
timeline.quote: as he forced himself out of dragon form

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan crashes down a crag and is buried by an avalanche.
timeline.quote: He held onto a thread of consciousness, enough to tell him that he was dying.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Yasova's sabertooth digs Sarkhan out, and Yasova begins healing him.
timeline.quote: It was Yasova's sabertooth cat, clearing snow with great swipes of its paws.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan blasts Yasova with dragon fire when she tries to stop him from saving Ugin.
timeline.quote: blasting Yasova full on in the chest

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds Ugin barely breathing at the bottom of the chasm.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan's heart leaped when he saw that a slow exhale was escaping the dragon's nostrils.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, hearing the mocking voice of his own mind, realizes the lesson and gives Ugin the hedron shard.
timeline.quote: "Ugin, I've brought something for you," he said.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan breathes on the hedron shard, which unfolds into a protective cocoon around Ugin.
timeline.quote: The protective cocoon assembled itself around Ugin now, hiding him away from Sarkhan

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the chain has a purpose, thanks Yasova, and is whisked away by temporal forces.
timeline.quote: —temporal forces whisked Sarkhan away.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol travels 1,280 years back in time to change the moment that sealed Tarkir's fate.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol travels 1,280 years back in time

citation.text: "Fate Reforged", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets khans of the past such as Yasova Dragonclaw, and Tarkir's history is rewritten.
timeline.quote: The history of Tarkir is rewritten.

citation.text: "Fate Reforged", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan arrives in Tarkir's past and sees dragons emerge from a storm.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan realized that he had arrived in Tarkir's past.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets Yasova Dragonclaw, who is guided by the voice of a golden dragon.
timeline.quote: The woman introduced herself as Yasova Dragonclaw

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Yasova's voice is Bolas and that he is coming to kill Ugin.
timeline.quote: The horns of Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas fights Ugin; Yasova's spell grips Sarkhan and Ugin is mortally wounded.
timeline.quote: Bolas struck against Ugin, who fended the Elder Dragon off

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan activates the hedron around the dying Ugin, preserving him and rewriting history.
timeline.quote: history had been reforged, and Sarkhan's life became an impossibility

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin's spirit sends Sarkhan back through the Nexus of Fate to prevent the dragon's death; Ugin is preserved in a hedron cocoon.
timeline.quote: Ugin was preserved in a hedron cocoon as he regained his strength.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Nexus of Fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that the sar-khan encased Ugin in a stone cocoon after she healed him, causing the tempests to return fourfold.
timeline.quote: He encased Ugin in a great stone cocoon inscribed with draconic runes.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is pulled back through time and finds himself before the weathered hedron cocoon, evidence that many years have passed.
timeline.quote: He was standing before the hedron cocoon, exactly where he had been a mere moment before

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees a herd of dragons overhead and understands that the dragons survived, then transforms and joins them.
timeline.quote: And in his dragon form, Sarkhan Vol took to the sky.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The herd roars with Sarkhan, and he sees changed land with five broods and new dragons from a tempest.
timeline.quote: As he shot back up into the herd, he was greeted by nothing less than the sight of a dragon tempest rupturing before him.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: A bell rings from a Mardu camp and an ancient dragon leads a herd of dragons up to meet Sarkhan; he sees the other timeline's rotting skull in her face.
timeline.quote: Shooting toward him was both the dragon of this now, flesh and blood and scales, and the dragon of the now that had been lost forever

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan lands at the Mardu camp and is attacked by the goblin Vial Smasher, whom he knew as Ankle Shanker and who doesn't recognize him.
timeline.quote: You're here! You're alive! Just like the dragon.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan transforms to shield Vial Smasher from her own thrown vial of dragonfire.
timeline.quote: As it shattered on the ground, Sarkhan transformed into a dragon and dove in front of Vial Smasher

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets Zurgo, now the bell-striker, who does not know Sarkhan and says no one says the word khan under Kolaghan Dragonlord.
timeline.quote: Kolaghan Dragonlord kill khan-sayers.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Zurgo mocks the name Vol and raises his dull blade; Sarkhan flees into the sky, realizing no one knows him in this changed Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Both orc and goblin stood in paralyzed stillness as Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Narset might be alive in this timeline and heads to Jeskai territory to find her.
timeline.quote: She would be here. She would be alive!

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan learns that the dragon Ojutai rules the Jeskai and follows word of Narset to the Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
timeline.quote: He followed word of her name up and up, ever closer to Ojutai's roost.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Master Taigam tells Sarkhan that Narset was a heretic punished to the full extent of the law and is no more.
timeline.quote: Narset is no more.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Taigam throws Sarkhan down the stairs; Sarkhan flies off in despair, resolving to wake Ugin to repair the timeline.
timeline.quote: It was time to wake the Spirit Dragon.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: In the looted archive beneath Dirgur, Narset reads the last scroll about the khans' summit and discovers Ojutai led the attack on them, which also reveals Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: One of those dragons had been Ojutai.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol travels back in time over a thousand years and saves Ugin from death, securing the dragon tempests.
timeline.quote: he traveled back in time more than a thousand years to a crucial turning point, and there he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ugin falls on Tarkir after fighting Nicol Bolas, carving the chasm of the Crucible.
timeline.quote: Ugin’s impact shattered the tundra, carving a massive chasm in the Qal Sisma mountains

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan defies Yasova and uses a hedron fragment to encase Ugin in a restorative cocoon.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan defied Yasova’s attempt to stop him

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin and Sarkhan reunite and discuss how Bolas manipulated Sarkhan and how he changed Tarkir's history.
timeline.quote: Ugin and Sarkhan reunited

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Having changed the past, Sarkhan Vol's story returns to Tarkir's present, where mighty Dragons now rule the skies and the five clans.
timeline.quote: Mighty Dragons now rule the skies and the five clans that comprise most of Tarkir's populace.

citation.text: "Dragons of Tarkir", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol alters Tarkir's timeline, erasing the original history of these locations.
timeline.quote: The history outlined below was erased by Sarkhan's actions.

citation.text: "Gudul delta", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan returns to a new Tarkir ruled by dragons and learns he can use blue mana.
timeline.quote: Dragons now ruled the plane thanks to the actions taken in the past

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The New Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan explains the old timeline to Ugin and Narset and plans to explore the new Tarkir with her.
timeline.quote: He then decides to accompany her to meet Ugin as they plan to explore the new Tarkir together.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The New Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan reflects, in flight, that everyone he knew lives changed, except himself and Narset, and resolves to ask Ugin.
timeline.quote: Everyone lived, it seemed, save two. Sarkhan. And Narset.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees blue-white light rise from Ugin's canyon and is harried by ghostly dragons that then retreat.
timeline.quote: Soon the spirit was joined by others.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds the hedron cocoon crumbled and Ugin alive, projecting images of Tarkir's dragons on the canyon wall.
timeline.quote: There, at the end of the canyon, a luminous shape towered, wings outstretched.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin deduces from the hedron shard that it came from the Eye after his defeat, and asks who Sarkhan is.
timeline.quote: I'm applying logic.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan explains his history: Ugin's spirit whispered to him, Bolas sent him to the Eye, and he later traveled back in time to save Ugin.
timeline.quote: When I stepped through I traveled back, before the dragons died, and tipped the scales of history.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan names Bolas as the one who sent him to the Eye to release the Eldrazi, and Ugin contains him briefly in a sphere of force before releasing him.
timeline.quote: He wanted it opened, the devourers released. He never told me why.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that Sarkhan's original Tarkir never existed, and that Sarkhan never was born in this history.
timeline.quote: you, Sarkhan Vol, stepped fully formed out of a shadow, a place that never existed.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin recounts that Sorin Markov woke him and spoke of foolishness at the Eye.
timeline.quote: An ally of mine, a vampire and a Planeswalker, woke me up and spoke to me of 'foolishness at the Eye.'

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan thanks Ugin and flies off to find Narset, certain she lives again.
timeline.quote: I say she lives again, and I will find her.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds this timeline's Narset walking through the snow; she doesn't know him but has read secret histories about the sar-khan.
timeline.quote: About a dragon-man, a sar-khan, who came from something called the Unwritten

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset reveals she traveled beyond Tarkir; Sarkhan explains planeswalkers and that three are in the valley.
timeline.quote: Planeswalker," said Sarkhan. "That's what we're called.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset goes to speak to Ugin and plans to study Atarka's ivory histories, content to stay on Tarkir for now; Sarkhan agrees.
timeline.quote: But this world has secrets enough. For right now…I'm right where I want to be.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan arrives on Tarkir, recalls his past and the ghost of Ugin urges him to find the doorway; he sets out for the mountains.
timeline.quote: who urges him to "find the doorway."

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Zurgo, mad with rage after his Mardu refuse to follow his personal quest, kills the challenger and leaves alone to hunt Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: Zurgo's command is challenged, and he kills the challenger

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset leads Sarkhan to the Nexus and stays to hold off Zurgo, who kills her; Sarkhan swears vengeance and steps through the gate.
timeline.quote: Zurgo overpowers Narset, killing her.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges in Tarkir's past, sees Atarka and Yasova, and realizes he has traveled back in time.
timeline.quote: He realizes the truth: he has traveled into Tarkir's past

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Sarkhan she follows a vision given by Bolas, and Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies off.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies away.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Bolas strikes down Ugin, Sarkhan wraps Ugin in a hedron cocoon, and is whisked back to an altered present; the dragon tempests intensify.
timeline.quote: Bolas strikes Ugin down as Sarkhan tumbles into the snow.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan awakens in the altered present, unable to revive Ugin, and finds Kolaghan, Vial Smasher, Zurgo and Taigam changed and not knowing him.
timeline.quote: He encounters the dragonlord Kolaghan

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds Ugin awake, learns he was never born in this timeline, and finds Narset, a Planeswalker exile; both are content to remain on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: both Planeswalkers agree that they are exactly where they wish to be.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.
